summary: Prevent fastio reads from rewriting tracked mirrors and add PLANFILE_MIRROR_WRITE

delivery.outcome: Prevent fastio reads and writes from dirtying Git-tracked .fast.json mirrors, surface tracked mirrors in audit_mirror, and support PLANFILE_MIRROR_WRITE=0 for side-effect-free reads.
nonGoals: Do not modify dependency manifests or lockfiles.

architecture.decision: Guard write_mirror, write_sprint_native, and read_yaml_native with mirror_write_enabled() and cached Git index inspection (is_tracked_mirror), and report tracked mirrors in audit_mirror.
interfaceChanges: mirror_write_enabled, find_tracked_mirrors, and is_tracked_mirror helpers in planfile.core.fastio
architecture.rollback: git revert of the fastio mirror write guard commit.

validation.evidence: Git repository fixture with tracked .fast.json mirror remains clean (git status --porcelain empty) after read_yaml_fast.
PLANFILE_MIRROR_WRITE=0 prevents mirror file creation while returning parsed YAML.
audit_mirror reports ok=False and healed=False when a mirror is tracked in git.
